_note_2026_10_03: Added 2026-10-03 after external review. The verdict and proposed_change strings are the first version's wording and are superseded by FINDINGS.md. 145th Street Bridge: the cause is modelling, not OSM; OSM records the sidewalks as sidewalk=right on East 149th Street, which this graph does not read. Broadway Bridge: the missing 9th Avenue crossing is unconfirmed. RFK Bronx span: the cause is the pipeline rule that drops cycleways with no foot tag, stricter than the US default foot=yes; no OSM edit is proposed. Two proposed_change strings named a mapper note that was removed from the repository; that reference was cut. No computed value in this file was changed.
stage_4_merge: For all five bridges the pedestrian shortest path in the built graph equals the path on the raw OSM ways that the Stage 1 and Stage 3 rules keep. Stage 4 cuts nothing here.

RFK Triborough Bridge, Bronx span.pipeline_rule: Stage 3, schema_map._classify_osm_edge: highway in SHARED_TYPES (cycleway, track) is kept only when foot is in FOOT_ALLOWED (yes, designated, permissive). Way 1414563386 has no foot tag.
RFK Triborough Bridge, Bronx span.proposed_change: Preferred: add foot=designated to OSM way 1414563386 and move the pin to a newer extract. No rule change. If the pipeline must fix it against the pinned extract, add an allow list of way IDs read by _classify_osm_edge with the single entry 1414563386. Do not relax the foot rule (see side_effects).
